messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: runtime-prod high error rate. Multiple containers in gpu-a pool crashlooping (SIGSEGV). Pager: @alex.keller. Incident channel opened.

alex.keller: Jumping in. seeing repeated segfaults during token generation. pods in CrashLoopBackOff with exit code 139.

mira.chen: I have logs. not an OOM — SIGSEGV inside fused_kernel.cu -> trt_plugin. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:11:08Z] runtime-engine[pid:8421]: segfault at 7ffde0 ip 00007f8a2b7c3d4 sp 00007fffd3a0e000 error 4 in libfused_kernel.so
stack: 0x7f8a2b7c3d4
  ... fused_kernel::run_batch +0x1a4
  ... trt::execute_plugin +0x3b
```

ben.ortiz: Customer impact: frontend metrics show 5xx spike for /v1/generate starting 02:09Z. Two large tenants (tenant-a, tenant-b) at ~90% error for last 8m. Alerting SLA owners.

sanjal.patel: Started draining affected nodes to prevent further churn. Redirected new requests to fallback pool (cpu-fallback) and small-1 model variant. Traffic shifted ~60%.

alex.keller: Can we disable fused kernels at runtime? env flag exists: `KERNEL_DISABLE_FUSED=1`. Pushing to canary deployment.

mira.chen: Confirmed env flag bypasses fused path locally — no crash on same workload. Suggest canary with KERNEL_DISABLE_FUSED=1.

eng-ml: This correlates with yesterday's quant-kernel rollout (package runtime-kernels v2.4). There are TRT plugin changes. Rolling back to v2.3 should avoid the segfault.

alex.keller: Preparing hotfix: build image `runtime:v2.3-rollback-20260315`. Will deploy to one AZ canary (pods runtime-canary-*) and monitor.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Canaried rollout started for runtime:v2.3-rollback-20260315 in us-west-2a.

mira.chen: Applying `kubectl set env deployment/runtime KERNEL_DISABLE_FUSED=true` on canary too, in case rollback misses something.

ben.ortiz: Noting customer comms: CS on standby. If canary looks good for 15m, we'll roll full cluster and send recovery note.

alex.keller: Canary pods stable for 4m, no segfaults. Error rates on canary traffic normalized to ~1% 5xx. Proceeding cluster-wide rollout.

ops_lead: Handing on-call to @ben.ortiz in 15m — ben you're primary for next shift. Keep an eye on node flaps. Also collect core dumps: if pod crashes with pid X run `kubectl cp` to grab /var/crash/core.X or exec `gcore`.

ben.ortiz: Got it. Collecting cores from one crashed pod now. Using `kubectl exec -it pod -- gcore 1` then scp to s3 (s3://redwood-incidents/2026-03-15/). Will attach link.

sanjal.patel: Rollout complete cluster-wide. All runtime pods now at runtime:v2.3-rollback-20260315 and KERNEL_DISABLE_FUSED=true. Crashloops stopped in gpu-a pool.

incident-bot: :tada: Service health: 99.8% for /v1/generate over last 10m. Tenants recovering. Incident severity will be evaluated after 1h cool-down.

mira.chen: Uploaded core + logs: s3://redwood-incidents/2026-03-15/cores/runtime-fusedkernel-8421.tar.gz. Eng-ML, please take offline for root cause (likely TRT plugin + quant path).

eng-ml: Received core. Initial triage: invalid pointer in fused kernel when using quantized int8 path + TRT plugin with cudnn/driver mismatch on driver 530.x. Repro harness started.

ben.ortiz: Customer impact summary for postmortem: ~12min outage window for affected tenants, peak error 90% for two tenants, overall 5xx volume returned to baseline after rollback.

ops_lead: Actions: 1) Postmortem and RCA (owner: eng-ml). 2) Add e2e canary test for quantized fused kernel path (owner: eng-ml + eng-runtime). 3) Improve crashdump automation to S3 (owner: eng-infra). 4) Communicate recovery to customers (owner: CS).

alex.keller: Leaving channel — ping me if stacktrace shows anything else. Thanks everyone.

ben.ortiz: Acknowledge handoff. Will follow up on postmortem doc and timeline.

incident-bot: :clipboard: Incident ticket updated: INC-2026-0315-042. Assigned owners noted. Close once postmortem attached.
